story.promise: Know which invoice to chase today.
story.hook: Who still owes you money? Scroll your email to find out.
story.problem: I scroll my email to remember who still owes me.
voiceover: Three invoices, all look the same.
One tap sorts them by days late.
Open it. Twelve days late, last reply Tuesday.
A polite reminder is already written.
You send it, and move on.
